Generate unreviewed cross-camera refractive fish match candidates

aqt_refractive_view_candidates.Rd

Generate geometrically plausible fish-pair hypotheses by tracing camera-local detections through two calibrated refractive models.

Usage

aqt_refractive_view_candidates(view_a, view_b, camera_a, camera_b,
  max_skew_s = 0.02, max_ray_separation = 0.5,
  max_candidates = 100000L)

Arguments

view_a, view_b

Two valid camera-local 2D image-space pixel aqt_tracks.

camera_a, camera_b

Externally calibrated compatible refractive camera models.

max_skew_s

Maximum timestamp skew after externally applied camera alignment.

max_ray_separation

Maximum physically permitted closest-ray residual.

max_candidates

Maximum number of time-compatible fish candidate pairs.

Value

Source-paired stereo candidate data frame with image, time, fish track, refractive XYZ, ray residual and validity. No biological identity certified.

Details

Camera exposure synchronization, intrinsic/extrinsic calibration and animal identity are external responsibilities. Original source video data are never used as ground-truth identities by this function.
